pwf.board.page.title: Deadline board for the whole portfolio
pwf.board.page.intro: Every open task of the projects within your scope, by the official colour of the three-colour policy.
pwf.board.official.notice: This screen shows the official colour only. The colour of a personal setting appears only in each person's own task list.

pwf.board.counts.title: Tasks by colour
pwf.board.count.formula: The open tasks that carry this colour across the portfolio within your scope, counted exactly on the server; not the number of rows shown on the screen.
pwf.board.count.source: The task table of the project workflow, official colour by the current three-colour policy
pwf.board.unknown.notice: {count} tasks have no countable deadline because a working calendar is missing. No date is guessed and these tasks are never shown green.
pwf.board.unknown.text: Deadline not computable, working calendar missing

pwf.board.list.caption: Open tasks by deadline, official colour
pwf.board.truncated.notice: The list is cut: the server returned only part of the {total} tasks. Narrow the filters or load more.
pwf.board.stale.notice: The figures were read at {at}, more than {minutes} minutes ago, so they may have changed.
pwf.board.partial.notice: The main board was read but the "{view}" part could not be. The counts by colour above are still right.
pwf.board.calendar.caption: Deadline calendar of {month}
pwf.board.calendar.day.label: {date}: {total} tasks due
pwf.board.calendar.pick.hint: Choose a day to see the tasks due.
pwf.board.calendar.selected.title: Tasks due on {date}
pwf.board.calendar.empty.text: No task is due this month.
pwf.board.calendar.range.text: Showing {shown} of {total} tasks of the month
pwf.board.calendar.truncated.notice: The calendar is cut: the server listed only part of the {total} tasks of the month. The count of each day is still right.
pwf.board.milestones.title: Milestones in the next {days} days, from {from} to {to}
pwf.board.milestones.caption: Milestones coming due
pwf.board.milestones.empty.text: No milestone falls in this period.
pwf.board.milestones.formula: Difference = the forecast date of the milestone in the current schedule minus its date in the first baseline,; positive is late.
pwf.board.milestones.source: The current schedule of the workflow and the first baseline of the project
pwf.board.workload.title: Workload by person and week
pwf.board.workload.display.notice: For viewing only. This screen does not balance the load and does not change who does a task automatically.
pwf.board.workload.caption: Planned working days left of each person by week
pwf.board.workload.empty.text: No task is assigned in this period.
pwf.board.workload.formula: The planned working days left of the open tasks that fall in that week, split by the assignment share of the person.
pwf.board.workload.source: The task table and the assignment ledger of the project workflow
